followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the 3 August 2018 Congolese-side service interruption and 4 August import/export vehicle restoration at Kasumbalesa. Maintain official-post import/export vehicles in both directions. Approach-road barriers and bus/taxi disruption are supporting context; informal movement is not assumed fully blocked. Retain the 3–4 August calendar interval and one-day difference. The sources do not establish an exact twenty-four-hour closure or the first reopening clock time. Retain Uncoded because the official reason is unexplained. NGOs’ political interpretation and Katumbi-related context are preserved as allegations, not established government intent. Radio Okapi’s substantive indexed article supplies return despite direct failure; Actualite.cd supplies approach observation; Jambordc reproduces one joint seven-NGO statement, not seven reporting origins. Retain unlocated Kasumbalesa scope with null coordinates. The NGO page’s illustrative Ofoo/Uganda photograph is excluded from geography evidence; no national frontier extent is inferred.
